name: ME Lisbon
insider_take: This sleek urban retreat puts you in the heart of Lisbon's designer district, where contemporary luxury meets Portuguese soul.
whats_special: ME Lisbon occupies a prime position on Avenida da Liberdade, Portugal's answer to the Champs-Élysées. The hotel's rooftop Level Eight bar offers stunning 360-degree views of the Tagus River and São Jorge Castle, while the building itself is a masterpiece of modern architecture that complements Lisbon's historic skyline.
pro_tip: Visit the rooftop bar at sunset for the most Instagram-worthy shots of Lisbon's golden hour, when the city's famous azulejo tiles catch the light across the historic neighborhoods below.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you steps away from luxury shopping on Avenida da Liberdade and a quick tram ride to the bohemian Bairro Alto district. The nearby Marquês de Pombal metro station connects you to Lisbon's iconic yellow Tram 28, which winds through the city's most photogenic neighborhoods.
pros: Prime location in Lisbon's cultural district with easy access to major attractions
Contemporary design with modern amenities and stylish interiors
Rooftop bar offering panoramic city views and vibrant atmosphere
Exceptional service from multilingual staff with local expertise
cons: Urban setting with potential street noise in some rooms
Modern minimalist style may not appeal to traditional luxury preferences
